mc.title: Feleletválasztós szókitöltés
mc.desc: Melyik szó illik a mondatba? (B2 First, Use of English 1. rész jellegű)

items.q: She finally ___ up her mind and accepted the job.
The concert was ___ off because of the storm.
He has a strong ___ for chocolate.
items.why: have a liking for = kedvelni valamit.

items.q: We need to ___ into account the cost of transport.
The new law will come into ___ next year.
I'm afraid I'm not ___ to make that decision.
The film was so boring that I nearly ___ asleep.
She ___ a great impression on the interviewers.
Prices have risen ___ over the last decade.
It's ___ thinking about before you sign.

wf.title: Szóképzés
wf.desc: Alakítsd át a zárójeles szót, hogy illjen a mondatba. (Use of English 3. rész jellegű)

items.q: The ___ of the new bridge took three years. (CONSTRUCT)
He was ___ about the results. (OPTIMISM)
Her ___ to help surprised everyone. (WILLING)
The instructions were completely ___. (UNDERSTAND)
It was a ___ decision. (SPONTANEITY)
There has been a significant ___ in sales. (GROW)
The hotel staff were extremely ___. (HELP)
Please ___ the form before Friday. (COMPLETE)
His ___ was obvious to everyone. (DISAPPOINT)
The museum is ___ to wheelchair users. (ACCESS)

kwt.title: Mondat-átalakítás kulcsszóval
kwt.desc: Írd át a mondatot a megadott szóval úgy, hogy a jelentés ne változzon (2–5 szó). (Use of English 4. rész jellegű)

items.q: I haven't been to the cinema for a year. (LAST)
items.a: It is a year since I last went to the cinema.
accept: it is a year since i last went
it's a year since i last went
it has been a year since i last went
it's been a year since i last went
items.why: It's/It has been + időtartam + since + múlt idő.

items.q: "Don't touch the paintings," the guard told us. (NOT)
items.a: The guard told us not to touch the paintings.
items.why: Tiltás függő beszédben: tell somebody not to do.

items.q: It wasn't necessary for you to bring food. (NEED)
I regret not studying harder. (WISH)
items.a: I wish I had studied harder.
items.why: I wish + past perfect = múltbeli megbánás.

items.q: They say he is very rich. (SAID)
items.a: He is said to be very rich.
items.why: Személyes szenvedő: be said to + ige.

items.q: Although it rained, we went out. (DESPITE)
items.a: Despite the rain, we went out.
accept: despite the fact that it rained

items.q: Somebody stole my bike last night. (WAS)
items.a: My bike was stolen last night.

items.q: It's possible that she missed the bus. (MIGHT)
items.a: She might have missed the bus.
